content: In Nafsat I, per Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka cites Shams al-Dīn Fanārī, chief qadi in Anatolia, who openly teaches mystical theory and is held in the highest regard throughout the Ottoman domains, and Ghazālī, and adds that all such works accord with the Sharīʿa and that the Quran forbids empty accusations and backbiting.
